nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $g$ and $d$, the uniform constant satisfies $c(g, d) \ge 1$.
nodes.title: The uniform Mordell–Lang constant is at least one

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $g$ and $d$, $c(g, d)$ is a natural number: the constant in the uniform bound on rational points of curves in Theorem 1.1 of Dimitrov, Gao and Habegger.
nodes.title: Uniform Mordell–Lang constant

nodes.summary: Let $C$ be a proper, smooth, geometrically irreducible curve over a field $k$, let $J(C)$ be its Jacobian, and let $P$ be a $k$-rational point of $C$. The Abel–Jacobi map $C \to J(C)$ based at $P$ sends $P$ to the identity point of $J(C)$ for its group scheme structure.
nodes.title: The Abel–Jacobi map sends the base point to zero

nodes.summary: Let $C$ be a proper, smooth, geometrically irreducible curve over a field $k$, let $J(C)$ be its Jacobian, let $P$ be a $k$-rational point of $C$, and let $\iota_P : C \to J(C)$ be the Abel–Jacobi map based at $P$. Let $A$ be a group scheme over $k$ that is smooth, proper and geometrically irreducible. For every morphism of $k$-schemes $f : C \to A$ sending $P$ to the identity point of $A$, there is a unique…
nodes.title: Universal property of the Jacobian

nodes.summary: For a field $k$ and a curve $C$ over $k$, that is, a $k$-scheme that is proper, smooth of relative dimension $1$ and geometrically irreducible, the genus of $C$ is a natural number.
nodes.title: Genus of a smooth proper curve

nodes.summary: Let $C$ be a proper, smooth, geometrically irreducible curve over a field $k$. The commutative group structure on the set of $k$-rational points of the Jacobian $J(C)$ is the one induced by its commutative group scheme structure: the product of two $k$-points $x$ and $y$ is $\mu \circ (x, y)$, where $\mu$ is the multiplication morphism of $J(C)$.
nodes.title: Group law on the rational points of the Jacobian

nodes.summary: For a field $k$ and a curve $C$ over $k$, that is, a $k$-scheme that is proper, smooth of relative dimension $1$ and geometrically irreducible, the Jacobian $J(C)$ of $C$ is a $k$-scheme.
nodes.title: Jacobian of a smooth proper curve

nodes.summary: Let $C$ be a proper, smooth, geometrically irreducible curve over a field $k$. Each $k$-rational point $P$ of $C$ gives a morphism of $k$-schemes $C \to J(C)$ from $C$ to its Jacobian, the Abel–Jacobi map based at $P$.
nodes.title: Abel–Jacobi map

nodes.summary: Let $C$ be a proper, smooth, geometrically irreducible curve over a field $k$. The Jacobian $J(C)$ is smooth of relative dimension $g$ over $k$, where $g$ is the genus of $C$.
nodes.title: The Jacobian has dimension equal to the genus

nodes.title: Uniform Mordell–Lang for curves

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
